obligations.expected_behavior: Execute the Stable subject for each of the six materially distinct Matrix Cases.
forbidden_result: Any of the six Matrix Cases omits Stable-subject execution.
Stable-subject execution is mutable during the Matrix Case run.
obligations.observable_result: Each of the six Matrix Cases has a completed execution record for an immutable Stable subject.
obligations.state_after: All six Matrix Cases have executed their immutable Stable subjects.
obligations.state_before: The six Matrix Cases are designated for execution, without a completed Stable-subject execution record for each case.
obligations.subject: Stable subject execution across all six materially distinct Matrix Cases
obligations.trigger: When the six Matrix Cases are executed

obligations.expected_behavior: Use distinct fixtures and state for the six materially distinct Matrix Case executions.
forbidden_result: Two materially distinct Matrix Cases use the same fixture or indistinguishable execution state.
Fixture or state is changed in a way that removes case distinction during execution.
obligations.observable_result: The execution records show case-specific fixture and state assignments that are distinct across all six Matrix Cases.
obligations.state_after: Each of the six Matrix Cases is executed with distinct fixture/state.
obligations.state_before: The six Matrix Cases are identified as materially distinct, but their execution fixtures/state have not yet been established as distinct.
obligations.subject: Fixture and state distinctness for Matrix Case executions
obligations.trigger: When preparing and running the six Matrix Cases

obligations.expected_behavior: Produce evidence attributable to the specific Matrix Case and executed Stable or Candidate subject.
forbidden_result: Evidence cannot be mapped to a specific Matrix Case.
Evidence cannot identify whether it belongs to the Stable or Candidate subject.
Evidence is produced without an attributable execution record.
obligations.observable_result: Every Matrix Case execution has evidence that identifies its case and subject.
obligations.state_after: Attributable evidence exists for all Stable and Candidate executions across the six Matrix Cases.

obligations.subject: Attributable evidence for Matrix Case executions
